note: Seed data for events.event_registry. Backend owns ingestion validation (PRO-7); Coder owns emission (PRO-6). event_name + event_version is the contract. Adding a field = bump event_version and add a new registry row; never repurpose an existing field.

piiClasses.none: No learner-authored content and no identifier beyond learner.public_ref.
piiClasses.pseudonymous: Tied to learner.public_ref only. Safe for self-hosted analytics; never joined to identity schema outside our infra.
piiClasses.content_hash: Contains a hash of learner-authored text. Hash only, never the text.

events.name: auth.signed_in
events.trigger: Successful sign-in of a learner profile.

events.name: auth.signed_out
events.trigger: Explicit sign-out.

events.name: session.started
events.trigger: First page load of a new session id.

events.name: session.heartbeat
events.trigger: Every 15s while document.visibilityState === 'visible' AND an input/scroll/pointer event occurred in the last 120s.

events.name: session.ended
events.trigger: beforeunload/pagehide (sendBeacon) or server-side idle close after 30m.

events.name: app.visibility_changed
events.trigger: document visibilitychange.

events.name: page.viewed
events.trigger: Client route change.

events.name: lesson.opened
events.trigger: Lesson view mounted.

events.name: lesson.reread
events.trigger: lesson.opened where the learner already has a prior lesson.closed with completed=true for this lesson_id.

events.name: lesson.scroll_depth
events.trigger: Crossing 25/50/75/100% of scrollable height, emitted once per threshold per open.

events.name: lesson.section_dwell
events.trigger: Section leaves the viewport, or lesson closes.

events.name: lesson.closed
events.trigger: Lesson view unmounted or session ends while open.

events.name: media.play
events.trigger: Video/animation playback starts or resumes.

events.name: media.progress
events.trigger: Playback crosses 25/50/75/95% of duration, once per threshold per play session.

events.name: media.paused
events.trigger: Playback paused.

events.name: media.seek
events.trigger: Seek committed.

events.name: media.completed
events.trigger: Playback reaches >=95% of duration.

events.name: exercise.started
events.trigger: Exercise set opened.

events.name: item.presented
events.trigger: Item becomes the active item on screen. Starts the pre-answer latency clock.

events.name: item.first_input
events.trigger: First keystroke/selection/drag on the active item. Emitted at most once per (item_id, attempt_no).

events.name: item.answer_changed
events.trigger: Answer value differs from the last settled value (debounced 800ms for text).

events.name: item.answer_submitted
events.trigger: Learner submits the item. Mirrors app.attempt.

events.name: item.result_shown
events.trigger: Grading result rendered for the item.

events.name: item.retried
events.trigger: Learner starts a new attempt on an item they already submitted.

events.name: item.skipped
events.trigger: Learner advances past an unanswered item.

events.name: item.abandoned
events.trigger: Active item left without submit or skip (navigate away / session end).

events.name: hint.requested
events.trigger: Learner opens a hint.

events.name: submission.draft_saved
events.trigger: Autosave (every 30s of active editing) or explicit save on an open-ended/project task.

events.name: submission.submitted
events.trigger: Learner submits work for AI grading.

events.name: submission.revised_after_feedback
events.trigger: A new draft is saved on a submission that already has an ai_verdict the learner viewed.

events.name: feedback.viewed
events.trigger: AI feedback panel enters the viewport for >=1s.

events.name: feedback.dwell
events.trigger: Feedback panel closed or navigated away from.

events.name: feedback.rated
events.trigger: Learner taps the helpful / not-helpful control. Also written to Langfuse as a score on the same trace id.

events.name: path.step_offered
events.trigger: Learning path recommendation rendered to the learner.

events.name: path.step_started
events.trigger: Learner opens the offered target.

events.name: path.step_completed
events.trigger: Offered target reaches its completion condition.

events.name: path.step_dismissed
events.trigger: Learner dismisses the recommendation or starts something else instead within the same session.

events.name: consent.granted
events.trigger: Guardian grants one or more consent scopes. Audit mirror of app.consent_record; the record is authoritative.

events.name: consent.revoked
events.trigger: Guardian revokes one or more consent scopes.
